scope: Dev13 only; Test40 not inspected or run
verification_context: The final C1-C10 chunks supplied to the tagged RAG system, shown to the judge for scientific-correctness verification of both answers
citation_neutrality: Do not reward or penalize citation presence or absence
Do not reward or penalize citation count, density, placement, formatting, or coverage
Use C-number markers only to locate evidence for scientific-correctness verification
An answer without citations remains eligible to win every criterion
scored_schema_policy: Every criterion preference and rationale is mandatory.
auxiliary_schema_policy: Missing confidence or material-error arrays are logged and normalized but never affect scores.
interpretation: Historical three-resample Dev13 sensitivity result. The model-visible payload exposed comparison metadata and the verification context belonged to the RAG arm. It is superseded by the Revision 3 neutral-evidence judge and must not be reported as the canonical result.
